theorems.name: ANISOTROPIC_UNSTABLE_EXIT_FLUX
theorems.domain: Lambda_plus,Lambda_minus,delta>0; Theta'=diag(Lambda_plus,Lambda_minus)*Theta; exit |Theta|=delta; smooth initial density f with f(0)>0
theorems.proof: Compute exact determinant of (partial_T Theta0, partial_psi Theta0); f(Theta0)->f(0) uniformly as T->infinity. Integral over psi a(psi)=pi*(Lambda_plus+Lambda_minus). For square exit, integrate each face's constant flux delta*Lambda_i*exp(-sum Lambda*T) over its remaining coordinate.
theorems.limitation: This is a local linear-flow theorem, not yet a theorem for global three-body scattering.

theorems.name: CONDITIONAL_ANISOTROPIC_CLOSE_APPROACH_AND_EJECTION_LAWS
assumptions: A stable-leaf-conditioned local return map exists with rho_min=kappa*exp(-v*T)*m(psi)*(1+o(1)) uniformly on compact collision-free outgoing angle windows.
kappa>0 and m(psi)>0 bounded from zero and infinity; initial unstable density smooth and positive at origin.
Positive ejection energy only on certified escaper branches with F(psi)>0; e_inf=F(psi)/rho_min; error uniform over selected windows.
theorems.ejection_velocity_tail: P(v_inf>v) has v^(-2*gamma) scaling under the same assumptions
theorems.note: The common amplitude C includes stable-leaf and sampling-density factors; no universal number without specified ensemble. For equal Lambda, a(psi) constant, recovering T18a-b weights.

theorems.name: ANGULAR_MOMENTUM_DOUBLE_SCALING_NECESSITY
theorems.exact_relation: c=J/sqrt(rho) on McGehee phase-space; if |c_exit|<=c_bound then |J|<=c_bound*sqrt(rho_exit)
theorems.scaling_variable: zeta_L=J/sqrt(r), r is threshold for closest size
theorems.conditional_planar_exponent: gamma_L=gamma+1/2 if J is an independent transverse coordinate with smooth nonzero density near J=0 and the exit shape/scattering map is uniformly regular
theorems.conditional_spatial_exponent: gamma_spatial=gamma+3/2 if three independent transverse angular-momentum components have regular nondegenerate density and uniform exit bounds
theorems.limitation: Extra exponent is not established solely by linear eigenvalues; the angular momentum fiber and nonlinear exit uniformity must be proved.

theorems.name: EQUAL_PAIR_RESONANCE_PARITY_CANCELLATION
theorems.involution: S=diag(1,-1,-1,1) acts on both q and p; exchange m1/m2 plus reflection
theorems.conclusion: c_res=d_res=kappa=0 exactly on equal-pair resonant point; no forced quadratic logarithms
theorems.proof: S-equivariance of Newton field, Hessian gap makes strong shape pair odd and weak shape pair even; the only two quadratic resonant monomials violate S-parity.
